info.title: Weavo Liquid Loom Universal API
info.description: Convert CSV, JSON, and XML payloads between structured and text formats with Weavo Liquid Loom transformation recipes.

post.description: Creates JSON output from CSV in Weavo Liquid Loom.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

liquidTemplate.description: Optional Liquid template code generated at weavo.dev. For CSV inputs, iterate over the parsed data array for custom mappings.

logFileName.description: Name of the log file. Only applicable when logging is enabled.
